heroBody: ChicMouse Studio is an indie team making polished mobile games — original ideas, fair play and no pay-to-win shortcuts. Just entertaining game design, refined down to the smallest detail.
stellarFusionTagline: Merge. Strategize. Compete across the cosmos.
featuredCardP1: Combine 3 matching celestial objects and watch them evolve into something grander — a star, a sun, a spiral of galaxies you built yourself.
featuredCardP2: Built for one thumb and whatever time you've got — quick sessions on the bus or a ranked PvP battle before bed. However you play, every move counts.
studioTextLeft: ChicMouse is an independent studio making games we'd happily play ourselves — original ideas, crafted from scratch, with one goal in mind: to genuinely entertain you.
studioTextRight: We'd rather ship one polished game than ten forgettable ones. No pay-to-win shortcuts, no lazy filler — just fair, fun design that respects your time and keeps you coming back.
pillar1Body: Every idea and mechanic gets one test that matters: is it actually fun? If it doesn't entertain you, it doesn't ship.
pillar2Body: No pay-to-win, no hidden paywalls for progress. If you're clever, you can win — compete on equal footing and climb where your skill takes you.
pillar3Body: Original worlds built from our own ideas, art, and code — crafted from scratch by our small team, never recycled.

stellarFusionDescP1: Stellar Fusion is a competitive merge puzzle built on a simple rule: every move matters. Place cosmic tiles on your board, combine 3 or more matching elements and trigger powerful chain reactions that evolve them into increasingly grand forms — planets become star systems, and star systems become galaxies.
stellarFusionDescP2: Designed for casual players and competitive minds alike, it pairs satisfying puzzles with real-time PvP battles and a ranked ladder. Climb from Bronze to Silver, Gold and beyond, earn ELO points, shield your progress and collect seasonal trophies across hundreds of handcrafted levels and daily challenges.
stellarFusionFeature1Body: Combine 3 or more matching cosmic tiles to trigger chain reactions and evolve them into increasingly advanced forms. Each merge reveals the next tier of a galaxy of your own making.
stellarFusionFeature2Body: Face players from around the world in live matches. Plan your moves, build bigger merges, unleash massive combos and outscore your rivals to climb the ELO ladder and move up the ranks.
stellarFusionFeature3Body: Jump in for a quick casual session or go all-in on the competitive climb — hundreds of handcrafted levels, daily missions and friend duels keep it fresh at your pace. Free to play, supported by low-key ads that never interrupt the action.
